gitCommit.subject: fix(design): implement Frosted shelf — visible sea-glass wash and frosted glass surfaces (#380)
gitCommit.body:
fix(design): implement Frosted shelf — visible sea-glass wash and frosted glass surfaces (#380)

* fix(design): implement Frosted shelf — visible sea-glass wash, frosted glass cards, panel, inputs and controls (purses-cw1p)

The wash was hidden by the app shell's opaque fill and tiled per viewport; cards, the item panel, inputs and secondary controls were opaque. Option A's tokens (2026-09-30 brainstorm) now drive the wash and glass, with composites and contrast rows for both themes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(design): frost every surface on the wash; viewport-sized wash blobs; gate links on glass at 4.5 (purses-cw1p)

Review fold: six pages still painted the opaque ground; panels, rows, notices, compare cards and the login/invitation cards were opaque surface slabs beside the glass. Photo controls get a hairline ring (a white rim vanishes over white photos); mint stop composited over the end stop it sits on; danger variant pinned; signed-out login screenshot surface.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(members): member rows are a list; e2e finds them by role, not by a styling class (purses-cw1p)

The Frosted shelf restyle broke an e2e that located rows by div.bg-surface-raised. Rows are now ul/li (announced as a list) and the spec uses getByRole('listitem').

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(a11y): no primary text on strong glass over photos; field errors in error-deep; visible photo-control hover (purses-cw1p)

Re-review: the pool bar's Clear was primary text on glass-strong over the photo grid (3.84:1 dark over a white photo; pre-existing) — now ink. Field error text/asterisks were text-error, ungated on glass (~4.06:1) — now error-deep with 4.5 rows on every wash stop and glass composite. Photo-control hover recolours the ring (dark fills too close to read).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* chore(graph): refresh after the Frosted shelf fix

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
